```{r}
# Average land price by township/district
hsinchu <- list("j_lvr_land_a.csv", "o_lvr_land_a.csv") %>%
lapply(function(file) {

df <- real_estate_data[[file]]

# Promote first row to header
colnames(df) <- as.character(unlist(df[1, ]))
df <- df[-1, , drop = FALSE]

# Select by name (more stable than column index)
df %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
    "The villages and towns urban district",
    "main use",
    "the unit price (NTD / square meter)"
  )))

}) %>%
bind_rows()

hsinchu <- hsinchu %>%
  filter(`main use` %in% c("住家用", "住商用", "住工用")) %>%
  rename(TOWNNAME = `The villages and towns urban district`) %>%
  rename(LANDPRICE = `the unit price (NTD / square meter)`)

hsinchu_ave_price <- hsinchu %>%
group_by(TOWNNAME) %>%
summarise(
avg_price = mean(parse_number(LANDPRICE), na.rm = TRUE),
.groups = "drop"
)

price_to_copy <- hsinchu_ave_price %>%
filter(TOWNNAME == "新竹市") %>%
pull(avg_price) %>%
first()

if (length(price_to_copy) == 1 && !is.na(price_to_copy)) {
hsinchu_ave_price <- hsinchu_ave_price %>%
add_row(
TOWNNAME = c("北區", "香山區", "東區"),
avg_price = price_to_copy
) %>%
filter(TOWNNAME != "新竹市")
}

hsinchu_ave_price
```

```{r}
standardize_cols <- function(df) {
df %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
}
```

```{r}
df_med <- bind_rows(
medical_data$medical_center %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "醫學中心"),
medical_data$hospital_regional %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "區域醫院"),
medical_data$hospital_local %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "地區醫院"),
medical_data$clinic %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "診所"),
medical_data$pharmacy %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "藥局")
)
```

```{r}
medical_summary <- df_med %>%
mutate(
地址 = iconv(地址, from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8", sub = ""),
地址 = str_replace_all(地址, "台", "臺"),
Region = str_extract(地址, "^.{2,3}?[縣市]"),
Address_Clean = str_remove(地址, "^.{2,3}?[縣市]"),
District = str_extract(Address_Clean, "^.+?[區鄉鎮市]"),
Weight = case_when(
Level == "醫學中心" ~ 10,
Level == "區域醫院" ~ 5,
Level == "地區醫院" ~ 3,
Level == "診所" ~ 1,
Level == "藥局" ~ 0.5,
TRUE ~ 0
)
) %>%
filter(!is.na(Region), !is.na(District)) %>%
group_by(Region, District) %>%
summarise(
Medical_Score = sum(Weight, na.rm = TRUE),
Facility_Count = n(),
.groups = "drop"
)

medical_hsinchu <- medical_summary %>%
filter(Region %in% c("新竹市", "新竹縣"))
```

) %>%

```{r}
hsinchu_core <- aging_hsinchu %>%
inner_join(land_hsinchu, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
left_join(medical_hsinchu, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
mutate(
Medical_Score = replace_na(Medical_Score, 0),
Facility_Count = replace_na(Facility_Count, 0)
)

hsinchu_core
```

```{r}
hsinchu_core <- hsinchu_core %>%
mutate(
avg_price = if_else(is.finite(avg_price) & avg_price > 0, avg_price, NA_real_),
Log_Price = log(avg_price),
Log_Medical = log(Medical_Score + 1),
Aging_Burden = A65UP_A15A64_RAT
) %>%
filter(
is.finite(Log_Price),
is.finite(Log_Medical),
!is.na(Aging_Burden)
)
hsinchu_core
```

names(sf_objs)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(biscale)

# 1) Choose the township boundary layer
town_sf <- map_data[["TOWN_MOI_1140318.shp"]] %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(
    TOWNNAME_key  = str_squish(TOWNNAME),
    COUNTYNAME_key = str_squish(COUNTYNAME)
  )

# 2) Filter map to your study area (Hsinchu City + Hsinchu County)
town_sf_hsinchu <- town_sf %>%
  filter(COUNTYNAME_key %in% c("新竹市", "新竹縣"))

# 3) Prepare your core table join key
core_keyed <- hsinchu_core %>%
  mutate(
    TOWNNAME_key = str_squish(District),
    Aging_Burden  = as.numeric(Aging_Burden),
    Medical_Score = as.numeric(Medical_Score),
    avg_price     = as.numeric(avg_price)
  )

# 4) Join attributes onto polygons
joined_sf <- town_sf_hsinchu %>%
  left_join(
    core_keyed %>% select(TOWNNAME_key, Aging_Burden, Medical_Score, avg_price),
    by = "TOWNNAME_key"
  )

# 5) Sanity check: are all your districts matched?
anti_join(
  core_keyed %>% distinct(TOWNNAME_key),
  town_sf_hsinchu %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% distinct(TOWNNAME_key),
  by = "TOWNNAME_key"
)

# 6) Bivariate map: Need vs Care (Aging_Burden vs Medical_Score)
map_need_care <- joined_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(Aging_Burden), !is.na(Medical_Score)) %>%
  bi_class(x = Aging_Burden, y = Medical_Score, style = "quantile", dim = 3)


```

```{r}
library(biscale)

get_bi_palette <- function(pal = "DkBlue", dim = 3) {
  p <- bi_pal(pal = pal, dim = dim, preview = FALSE)

  # Some versions return a function; some return a vector
  if (is.function(p)) p <- p(dim * dim)

  # If unnamed, assign the standard biscale class order (x varies fastest)
  if (is.null(names(p))) {
    names(p) <- c(
      "1-1","2-1","3-1",
      "1-2","2-2","3-2",
      "1-3","2-3","3-3"
    )
  }

  p
}

pal_vec <- get_bi_palette("DkBlue", 3)

```

```{r}
labels_need_care <- c(
  "1-1" = "Low need / Low care",
  "1-2" = "Low need / Mid care",
  "1-3" = "Low need / High care",
  "2-1" = "Mid need / Low care",
  "2-2" = "Mid need / Mid care",
  "2-3" = "Mid need / High care",
  "3-1" = "High need / Low care (Inverse care)",
  "3-2" = "High need / Mid care",
  "3-3" = "High need / High care"
)
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

map_need_care_lab <- map_need_care %>%
  mutate(label_pt = st_point_on_surface(geometry)) %>%
  st_set_geometry("label_pt")

ggplot(map_need_care) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = bi_class), color = NA) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = map_need_care_lab,
    aes(label = TOWNNAME),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal_vec,
    breaks = names(labels_need_care),
    labels = labels_need_care,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bivariate Map: Need vs Care (Hsinchu Region)",
    subtitle = "Need = Aging_Burden; Care = Medical_Score (3x3 quantiles)",
    fill = "Need–Care"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
